Question Choices: Fill: Find the volume of a cone with radius 3 and height 10. (Enter the coefficient of $\pi$ only)
Solution: Use πr²h/3. The coefficient of π is (3)²×10/3=30. The volume is (30)π cubic units. Enter only the coefficient: 30.
